name: runopencode/intent
description: A library for temporary storing intents (messages/commands/states) which needs to be preserved between stateless requests.

suggest.doctrine/dbal: Required by "RunOpenCode\Component\Intent\Storage\DbalStorage" to store intents within a database table.
suggest.doctrine/orm: Required by "RunOpenCode\Component\Intent\Storage\DbalStorage" to contribute the intent storage table to the generated schema.
suggest.symfony/console: Required by "RunOpenCode\Component\Intent\Command\ClearExpiredIntentsCommand" to remove expired intents from the storage.
